maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from carriers paying for consumer leads and customer acquisition in auto and home insurance, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paying customers are private insurance carriers and agents; consumers use the quote service free.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through its online insurance marketplace and AI matching; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Carriers buy leads and referrals from many sources and can shift marketing spend easily; no integration lock-in.
